supplier_objections.statement: Suppliers cited repatriation of funds in the preferred currency and high transaction costs of conversion along with exchange-fluctuation risk; IOC incurred high transaction costs as suppliers passed the extra costs on.

lcs_claim.statement: Indian traders pay ~2% average transaction cost when exporting to the UAE; the India-UAE Local Currency Settlement framework (RBI-CBUAE MoU, 2023) removes conversion through a third currency. Not quantified in basis points.

august_fall_reasons: Ukrainian drone strikes (~40% of Russian export capacity removed by March 2026, per one analysis)
China outbidding (Russian imports ~1.7 mb/d in August vs ~1.4 in July)

discount_to_brent_reports.note: one source: discounts widened to more than $10
another source: approximate parity or slight premium - CONFLICTS with the July report

freight_usd_bbl.note: from one analysis; freight premium of ~$7/bbl constrains discount depth

refiners.Reliance: purchases fell to ~292,000 b/d (EU rules on products from Russian crude)
refiners.Nayara: ~400,000 b/d after maintenance; already under sanctions

russia_news_2026.us_waivers: 30-day US waiver for stranded Russian cargoes (March 2026), a second waiver, and reported expiry/lapse by May-June 2026; not a broad relaxation

indian_basket_14_sep_2026_usd_bbl.source: BusinessToday 15 Sep 2026 (fetched); differs from the $112.97 obtained by applying PPAC's formula to the 21-Sep live feed (Dubai used for Oman)

russia_news_2026.payment_currency_for_russian_crude: NOT found in any source; rupee-settled imports rose sharply in Mar-May 2026 (EcoNiti) alongside Russian purchases, which is circumstantial
